system.description:
A single touch withers a victim's limb into a fragile, useless husk, the warping power of destruction crippling flesh and bone.

Strike your target with a Physical Challenge; on a hit you wither one arm or leg, giving the victim the Negative Traits Clumsy and Lame. A victim without arms cannot grapple or wield weapons, and one without functional legs cannot move; further strikes wither other limbs cumulatively. The effect is permanent on mortals, though vampires may heal a crippled limb as if it were a single aggravated wound. Casting takes a single turn. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Permanent on mortals; heals as aggravated wound on vampires
